label: Ban
description: Manual timed bans by referees/admins. Leaver auto-ban tracking is a separate plugin (leaverban.py), which owns the qlx_leaverBan* cvars and forgive/gamestats/tracked commands.

commands.name: ban
commands.description: Bans a player temporarily for the given length.

commands.name: unban
commands.description: Unbans the specified player if banned.

commands.name: checkban
commands.description: Checks whether a player has been banned, and if so, the reason.
